recipes.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti until al dente.
Fry pancetta in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
Whisk together eggs, Pecorino Romano, and Parmesan in a bowl. Season with black pepper.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain the spaghetti.
Remove pan from heat, add pasta to pancetta, then pour egg mixture over it.
Toss quickly, adding pasta water gradually until creamy. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Penne Arrabbiata
instructions: Cook penne in salted boiling water until al dente.
Sauté garlic and red chili flakes in olive oil over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes. Season with salt.
Drain pasta and toss with the arrabbiata sauce.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Fettuccine Alfredo
instructions: Cook fettuccine in salted boiling water until al dente.
Melt butter in a large pan over low heat.
Add heavy cream and simmer gently for 3 minutes.
Stir in Parmesan until sauce is smooth and creamy.
Drain pasta and toss with sauce. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve immediately with extra Parmesan.

recipes.title: Lasagna Bolognese
instructions: Brown ground beef and pork with onion, garlic, and carrot in olive oil.
Add tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, and red wine. Simmer 30 minutes.
Make béchamel: melt butter, whisk in flour, then gradually add milk until thick.
Layer lasagna sheets, bolognese, and béchamel in a baking dish.
Top with Parmesan and bake at 180°C for 35 minutes until golden.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

recipes.title: Cacio e Pepe
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Toast coarsely ground black pepper in a dry pan for 1 minute.
Add a splash of pasta water to the pan and let it reduce.
Remove from heat, add drained pasta and toss.
Add Pecorino Romano and Parmesan gradually with pasta water, tossing vigorously.
Serve immediately with extra pepper.

recipes.title: Tagliatelle with Mushroom Cream Sauce
instructions: Cook tagliatelle in salted boiling water until al dente.
Sauté sliced mushrooms in butter with garlic until golden, about 8 minutes.
Add white wine and let it reduce for 2 minutes.
Pour in heavy cream and simmer until thickened. Season with salt and pepper.
Toss drained pasta with the sauce.
Serve with Parmesan and fresh thyme.

recipes.title: Pasta Puttanesca
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Sauté garlic and anchovies in olive oil until anchovies dissolve.
Add crushed tomatoes, olives, capers, and chili flakes. Simmer 15 minutes.
Toss drained pasta with the sauce.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Rigatoni alla Norma
instructions: Salt eggplant cubes and let rest 20 minutes, then pat dry.
Fry eggplant in olive oil until golden. Set aside.
Sauté garlic in olive oil, add crushed tomatoes and basil. Simmer 15 minutes.
Cook rigatoni until al dente.
Toss pasta with sauce and eggplant.
Top with ricotta salata and fresh basil. Serve.

recipes.title: Pasta e Fagioli
instructions: Sauté onion, celery, carrot, and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add rosemary, tomato paste, and cannellini beans. Cook 5 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth and simmer 20 minutes.
Blend half the soup for a creamy texture, then return to pot.
Add ditalini pasta and cook until tender.
Season with salt, pepper, and extra olive oil before serving.

recipes.title: Bucatini all'Amatriciana
instructions: Cook guanciale in a pan until crispy. Remove and set aside.
Sauté chili flakes and white wine in the same pan for 2 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Cook bucatini in salted water until al dente.
Toss pasta with sauce and guanciale.
Serve with grated Pecorino Romano.

recipes.title: Orecchiette with Broccoli Rabe
instructions: Blanch broccoli rabe in boiling salted water for 3 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Cook orecchiette in the same water until al dente.
Sauté garlic, chili, and anchovies in olive oil until fragrant.
Add broccoli rabe and toss for 2 minutes.
Drain pasta and combine with broccoli mixture.
Serve with a drizzle of olive oil and Pecorino.

recipes.title: Gnocchi al Pomodoro
instructions: Sauté garlic in olive oil, add crushed tomatoes and fresh basil. Simmer 10 minutes.
Cook gnocchi in salted boiling water until they float to the surface.
Remove gnocchi with a slotted spoon and add to the tomato sauce.
Toss gently and serve with Parmesan and fresh basil.

recipes.title: Spaghetti alle Vongole
instructions: Soak clams in cold salted water for 30 minutes to remove grit.
Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Sauté garlic and chili in olive oil. Add clams and white wine.
Cover and cook until clams open, about 5 minutes. Discard any that stay closed.
Toss drained pasta with the clam sauce.
Garnish with fresh parsley and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: Cook penne in salted boiling water until al dente.
Sauté zucchini, bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, and asparagus in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 1 more minute.
Toss vegetables with drained pasta and Parmesan.
Season with salt, pepper, and fresh basil. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Mac and Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain.
Melt butter in a saucepan, whisk in flour and cook 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in milk and cook until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in cheddar and Gruyère until melted.
Combine sauce with pasta. Transfer to a baking dish.
Top with breadcrumbs and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Linguine with Pesto and Green Beans
instructions: Blend basil, pine nuts, Parmesan, garlic, and olive oil into a smooth pesto.
Cook linguine in salted boiling water. Add green beans in the last 5 minutes.
Reserve pasta water, drain pasta and beans.
Toss with pesto, adding pasta water to loosen.
Serve with extra Parmesan and pine nuts.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Sauté onion, carrot, and celery in olive oil until soft.
Add ground beef and cook until browned.
Add tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, red wine, and milk. Season with salt and pepper.
Simmer on low heat for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook spaghetti until al dente and toss with the sauce.
Serve with Parmesan and fresh basil.

recipes.title: Tortellini in Brodo
instructions: Bring a rich beef or chicken broth to a gentle simmer.
Add fresh tortellini and cook according to package instructions.
Ladle into bowls with generous amounts of broth.
Serve with grated Parmesan and a crack of black pepper.

recipes.title: Farfalle with Salmon and Cream
instructions: Cook farfalle in salted boiling water until al dente.
Sauté shallot in butter until translucent.
Add smoked salmon pieces and cook 1 minute.
Pour in cream and simmer until thickened. Add lemon zest.
Toss drained pasta with the salmon cream sauce.
Serve with fresh dill and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Pasta Fagioli con Salsiccia
instructions: Brown Italian sausage, breaking it up, in a large pot.
Add onion, garlic, carrot, and celery. Cook until soft.
Stir in tomato paste, beans, and chicken broth. Simmer 20 minutes.
Add ditalini and cook until tender.
Season with salt, pepper, and fresh rosemary.
Serve with crusty bread and olive oil.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Thinly slice garlic and gently toast in olive oil until golden.
Add chili flakes and a ladle of pasta water. Stir to emulsify.
Drain pasta and toss in the garlic oil.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Ravioli with Butter and Sage
instructions: Cook fresh ravioli in salted boiling water until they float.
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat until it starts to foam.
Add fresh sage leaves and cook until butter turns light brown and sage is crispy.
Drain ravioli and toss in the browned butter and sage.
Serve with Parmesan and a pinch of nutmeg.

recipes.title: Pasta al Forno
instructions: Cook rigatoni until slightly underdone. Drain.
Make a tomato meat sauce with ground beef, crushed tomatoes, and herbs.
Mix pasta with sauce, mozzarella cubes, and hard-boiled eggs.
Transfer to a baking dish and top with more sauce and Parmesan.
Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Rest 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Cold Sesame Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles according to package, rinse under cold water, and drain.
Whisk together tahini, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, ginger, and garlic.
Toss noodles with the sesame sauce.
Top with julienned cucumber, shredded carrot, and green onions.
Garnish with sesame seeds and chili oil. Serve cold.

recipes.title: Pad Thai
instructions: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 20 minutes. Drain.
Mix fish sauce, tamarind paste, sugar, and lime juice for the sauce.
Stir-fry shrimp and tofu in oil until cooked. Push to the side.
Scramble eggs in the pan, then add noodles and sauce.
Toss everything together over high heat for 2 minutes.
Serve with bean sprouts, peanuts, lime, and green onions.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, cumin, turmeric, and garam masala for 1 hour.
Grill or broil chicken until slightly charred, about 10 minutes.
Sauté onion in butter until golden. Add garlic and ginger, cook 2 minutes.
Add tomato puree, cream, and spices. Simmer 10 minutes.
Add grilled chicken and simmer 10 more minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Roast Chicken with Herbs
instructions: Pat chicken dry and season generously inside and out with salt and pepper.
Stuff cavity with lemon halves, garlic, and fresh herbs.
Rub skin with softened butter mixed with thyme and rosemary.
Roast at 200°C for 1 hour 20 minutes, basting every 30 minutes.
Let rest 15 minutes before carving.
Serve with pan juices and roasted vegetables.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Salad
instructions: Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and olive oil. Grill 6 minutes per side.
Whisk together mayonnaise, lemon juice, Worcestershire, anchovy paste, and Parmesan for dressing.
Toss chopped romaine lettuce with Caesar dressing.
Slice grilled chicken and place on top.
Garnish with croutons, shaved Parmesan, and black pepper.

recipes.title: Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Slice chicken into strips and season with cumin, chili powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Cook chicken in a hot cast iron pan with oil until charred and cooked through.
Remove chicken and sauté sliced bell peppers and onion until tender.
Serve chicken and vegetables in warm flour tortillas.
Top with sour cream, guacamole, salsa, and fresh lime.

recipes.title: Chicken Piccata
instructions: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness. Season with salt and pepper.
Dredge in flour and shake off excess.
Pan-fry in olive oil and butter until golden, 3 minutes per side. Remove.
Add white wine to the pan and reduce by half.
Add chicken broth, lemon juice, and capers. Simmer 3 minutes.
Return chicken to pan, spoon sauce over. Serve with fresh parsley.

recipes.title: Butter Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, garam masala, turmeric, and chili for 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry chicken until cooked. Set aside.
Melt butter and sauté onion, garlic, ginger until soft.
Add tomato puree, kashmiri chili, and spices. Cook 10 minutes.
Blend sauce until smooth. Return to pan and add cream.
Add chicken and simmer 10 minutes. Serve with naan and rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Marsala
instructions: Pound chicken breasts thin. Season and dredge in flour.
Pan-fry in olive oil and butter until golden. Remove and set aside.
Sauté mushrooms in the same pan until golden.
Add Marsala wine and reduce by half.
Add chicken broth and simmer 5 minutes.
Return chicken to pan and cook 5 more minutes. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: General Tso's Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into chunks and marinate in soy sauce, egg, and cornstarch.
Deep fry chicken until crispy and golden. Drain on paper towels.
Make sauce: soy sauce, hoisin, rice vinegar, sugar, garlic, ginger, and chili.
Stir-fry sauce in a wok for 1 minute.
Add fried chicken and toss to coat.
Serve over steamed rice with broccoli and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma
instructions: Marinate chicken in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, and turmeric for 2 hours.
Grill or roast chicken at 220°C until cooked through and slightly charred.
Slice chicken thinly.
Serve in flatbread with garlic sauce, tomatoes, cucumbers, and pickled turnip.
Drizzle with tahini and fresh herbs.

recipes.title: Coq au Vin
instructions: Brown chicken pieces in butter and oil in a Dutch oven. Remove.
Sauté pearl onions, mushrooms, and bacon until golden.
Add garlic, tomato paste, and flour. Cook 2 minutes.
Pour in red wine and chicken stock. Add thyme and bay leaf.
Return chicken, cover and braise at 160°C for 1 hour 15 minutes.
Adjust seasoning and serve with crusty bread or mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmigiana
instructions: Pound chicken breasts thin. Dredge in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs.
Pan-fry in oil until golden on both sides.
Place on a baking tray, top with tomato sauce and mozzarella.
Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve with spaghetti and fresh basil.

recipes.title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Sauté onion in oil until golden. Add garlic and ginger.
Add curry powder, cumin, coriander, and turmeric. Cook 2 minutes.
Add chicken pieces and brown on all sides.
Pour in coconut milk and crushed tomatoes. Simmer 25 minutes.
Season with salt and garnish with cilantro.
Serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Chicken Souvlaki
instructions: Cut chicken into cubes and marinate in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, and paprika.
Thread onto skewers and grill over high heat 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Make tzatziki: mix yogurt, grated cucumber, garlic, dill, and lemon.
Serve skewers in warm pita with tzatziki, tomatoes, and onion.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Chicken
instructions: Season chicken thighs with salt and pepper.
Pan-sear in oil, skin side down, until golden. Flip and cook 5 more minutes.
Mix honey, soy sauce, garlic, and butter in a bowl.
Pour sauce over chicken and cook 5 minutes, basting frequently.
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Tagine with Preserved Lemon
instructions: Brown chicken pieces in olive oil in a tagine or Dutch oven.
Sauté onion and garlic until soft. Add ras el hanout, ginger, and saffron.
Add chicken broth, preserved lemon, and green olives.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 45 minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and parsley.
Serve with couscous or flatbread.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Cook and shred chicken breast. Season with cumin, chili powder, and salt.
Mix chicken with cream cheese and half the shredded cheese.
Fill tortillas with chicken mixture, roll tightly, and place in a baking dish.
Pour enchilada sauce over the top and sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes until bubbly.
Garnish with sour cream, avocado, and cilantro.

recipes.title: Chicken and Mushroom Pie
instructions: Cook diced chicken and mushrooms in butter until golden.
Make a sauce with flour, chicken stock, and cream. Season well.
Combine chicken mixture with sauce. Allow to cool.
Pour filling into a pie dish. Top with puff pastry, crimping edges.
Brush with egg wash and bake at 200°C for 30 minutes until golden.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken
instructions: Mix olive oil, lemon zest, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, and thyme.
Marinate chicken for at least 30 minutes.
Grill over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with Greek salad and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Chicken Adobo
instructions: Combine soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves, and peppercorns in a pot.
Add chicken pieces and marinate 30 minutes.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes, turning occasionally.
Remove chicken and pan-fry in oil until golden and crispy.
Reduce the braising liquid until syrupy and pour over chicken.
Serve with steamed white rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Schnitzel
instructions: Pound chicken breasts to 5mm thickness between plastic wrap.
Season, then coat in flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs in that order.
Pan-fry in clarified butter over medium-high heat, 3-4 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve with potato salad, lemon wedges, and lingonberry jam.

recipes.title: Thai Green Chicken Curry
instructions: Fry green curry paste in a wok with a splash of coconut milk for 2 minutes.
Add sliced chicken and stir-fry until sealed.
Pour in remaining coconut milk and chicken broth. Bring to a simmer.
Add Thai eggplant, zucchini, and fish sauce. Cook 10 minutes.
Stir in fresh basil and lime juice.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Katsu
instructions: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness. Season with salt and pepper.
Coat in flour, egg, and panko breadcrumbs.
Deep-fry at 170°C for 5-6 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Make katsu sauce: mix Worcestershire, ketchup, soy sauce, and sugar.
Slice chicken and serve over steamed rice with shredded cabbage and sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Quesadillas
instructions: Season and cook chicken breast, then shred.
Mix chicken with sautéed peppers, onion, and spices.
Lay a tortilla flat, add cheese and chicken mixture on half.
Fold over and cook in a dry pan until golden on both sides.
Slice into wedges and serve with salsa, sour cream, and guacamole.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Simmer whole chicken in water with onion, celery, carrot, and bay leaf for 30 minutes.
Remove chicken, shred the meat, and discard bones and skin.
Strain broth and return to pot.
Add sliced carrots, celery, and onion to the broth. Simmer 10 minutes.
Add egg noodles and shredded chicken. Cook until noodles are tender.
Season with salt, pepper, and fresh parsley.

recipes.title: Chicken Biryani
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, biryani spices, and fried onion for 1 hour.
Parboil basmati rice with whole spices until 70% cooked.
Layer chicken at the bottom of a heavy pot, top with rice.
Add saffron milk, fried onions, and ghee.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat (dum) for 30 minutes.
Serve with raita and pickled onions.

recipes.title: Classic Beef Burger
instructions: Mix ground beef with Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Form into 4 patties, pressing a dimple in the center of each.
Grill over high heat for 3-4 minutes per side for medium doneness.
Add cheese in the last minute and let it melt.
Toast buns on the grill.
Serve with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, ketchup, and mustard.

recipes.title: Beef Stew
instructions: Cut beef into 3cm chunks. Season well with salt and pepper.
Brown beef in batches in oil in a Dutch oven. Remove and set aside.
Sauté onion, carrots, and celery until softened.
Add garlic, tomato paste, and flour. Cook 2 minutes.
Pour in beef stock and red wine. Add thyme and bay leaves.
Return beef, add potatoes. Cover and simmer 1.5 hours until tender.
Adjust seasoning and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Beef Tacos
instructions: Brown ground beef in a pan, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add taco seasoning and water. Simmer until absorbed.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry pan or directly over flame.
Fill tacos with beef, shredded cheese, and your choice of toppings.
Top with pico de gallo, sour cream, guacamole, and fresh cilantro.
Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Beef Wellington
instructions: Sear beef tenderloin in hot oil until browned all over. Cool completely.
Brush with English mustard.
Blend mushrooms into a fine duxelles and cook until dry. Cool.
Lay prosciutto on plastic wrap, spread duxelles, place beef on edge and roll tightly. Refrigerate 30 minutes.
Wrap in puff pastry, seal edges, and brush with egg wash.
Bake at 220°C for 25 minutes for medium-rare. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Beef Bulgogi
instructions: Slice beef thinly against the grain. Freeze for 30 minutes for easier slicing.
Mix soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and pear juice for marinade.
Marinate beef for at least 1 hour.
Cook in a hot wok or grill pan over high heat for 2-3 minutes.
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Slice beef into thin strips. Season with salt and pepper.
Sear beef quickly in a hot pan with oil. Remove and set aside.
Sauté onion and mushrooms until golden.
Add garlic and tomato paste. Cook 1 minute.
Pour in beef broth and Worcestershire. Simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in sour cream and return beef. Heat gently and serve over egg noodles.

recipes.title: Beef Rendang
instructions: Blend shallots, garlic, ginger, lemongrass, galangal, and chilies into a paste.
Fry paste in oil until fragrant, about 10 minutes.
Add beef chunks and stir to coat.
Pour in coconut milk and add toasted coconut, kaffir lime leaves, and turmeric.
Simmer uncovered on low heat for 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Cook until liquid is absorbed and beef is dark and tender. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Steak with Chimichurri
instructions: Bring steaks to room temperature. Season generously with salt and pepper.
Sear in a cast iron pan with oil over high heat, 3 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Rest steaks for 5 minutes.
Make chimichurri: blend parsley, oregano, garlic, red wine vinegar, olive oil, and chili flakes.
Slice steak and serve with chimichurri and roasted potatoes.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli Stir Fry
instructions: Slice beef thinly and marinate in soy sauce, cornstarch, and sesame oil.
Make sauce: oyster sauce, soy sauce, beef broth, sugar, and cornstarch.
Blanch broccoli florets for 2 minutes. Drain.
Stir-fry beef over high heat until browned. Remove.
Stir-fry garlic and ginger, add broccoli, then beef and sauce.
Toss everything together until sauce thickens. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Beef Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
instructions: Mix ground beef with breadcrumbs, egg, Parmesan, garlic, and herbs.
Roll into golf ball sized meatballs.
Brown meatballs in olive oil on all sides. Remove.
Make tomato sauce with garlic, crushed tomatoes, basil, and seasoning.
Add meatballs to sauce and simmer 20 minutes.
Serve with spaghetti or crusty bread.

recipes.title: Beef Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef in a large pot. Drain excess fat.
Add onion, bell pepper, and garlic. Cook until soft.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, paprika, and cayenne.
Add crushed tomatoes, kidney beans, and beef broth.
Simmer uncovered for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve with sour cream, cheddar, green onions, and cornbread.

recipes.title: Beef Kebabs
instructions: Mix ground beef with grated onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, paprika, and salt.
Knead well for 2 minutes until mixture is sticky.
Shape onto metal skewers into long sausage shapes.
Grill over high heat for 4-5 minutes per side.
Serve with flatbread, hummus, tahini, tomatoes, and onion salad.

recipes.title: Beef Pot Roast
instructions: Season chuck roast generously with salt and pepper.
Sear all sides in a Dutch oven until deeply browned.
Remove beef and sauté onion, carrots, and celery.
Add garlic, tomato paste, red wine, and beef broth.
Return beef with potatoes, thyme, and rosemary.
Cover and braise in oven at 160C for 3 hours until fork tender.

recipes.title: Beef Pho
instructions: Char onion and ginger directly over flame until blackened.
Simmer beef bones with charred onion, ginger, star anise, cinnamon, and cloves for 3 hours.
Strain broth and season with fish sauce and salt.
Cook rice noodles according to package.
Divide noodles into bowls, top with thinly sliced raw beef.
Pour boiling broth over to cook the beef. Serve with bean sprouts, basil, lime, and chili.

recipes.title: Beef Empanadas
instructions: Cook ground beef with onion, garlic, cumin, paprika, and chili flakes.
Add chopped hard-boiled eggs, green olives, and raisins. Cool completely.
Roll out pastry dough and cut into circles.
Fill each circle with beef mixture, fold, and crimp edges.
Brush with egg wash and bake at 200C for 20-25 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Beef Shawarma
instructions: Marinate beef strips in shawarma spices, yogurt, lemon, and garlic for 2 hours.
Cook beef in a hot pan or grill until charred and cooked through.
Warm flatbreads on the grill.
Layer beef with garlic sauce, pickled vegetables, and tomatoes.
Roll tightly and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Beef Lasagna
instructions: Make bolognese: brown beef with onion, carrot, celery, garlic, wine, and tomatoes. Simmer 30 min.
Make bechamel: cook butter and flour, add milk gradually until thick.
Layer lasagna sheets, bolognese, and bechamel in a deep baking dish.
Finish with bechamel, mozzarella, and Parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake at 180C for 30 minutes.
Remove foil and bake 15 more minutes until golden. Rest before serving.

recipes.title: Ribeye Steak with Garlic Butter
instructions: Take steaks out of fridge 30 minutes before cooking.
Season generously with salt and coarse black pepper on both sides.
Heat cast iron pan until smoking. Add oil and sear steaks 3-4 minutes per side.
Add butter, garlic, and thyme to pan. Baste steaks continuously for 2 minutes.
Rest steaks on a rack for 5-10 minutes.
Slice against the grain and serve with the pan butter.

recipes.title: Beef Kofta Curry
instructions: Mix ground beef with onion, garlic, ginger, garam masala, and fresh herbs.
Shape into small balls and fry until browned. Set aside.
Make curry: fry onion, garlic, ginger, and spices until fragrant.
Add tomatoes and cook until oil separates.
Add koftas and simmer in the curry for 20 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with naan or rice.

recipes.title: Beef Bourguignon
instructions: Brown bacon lardons in a Dutch oven. Remove.
Brown beef cubes in batches in the bacon fat. Remove.
Saute pearl onions, carrots, and mushrooms until golden.
Add garlic, tomato paste, and flour. Cook 2 minutes.
Pour in red wine and beef stock. Add herbs and return beef and bacon.
Braise covered at 160C for 2 hours until tender. Serve with mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Beef Gyros
instructions: Marinate beef strips in olive oil, lemon, garlic, oregano, and paprika.
Grill or pan-fry beef until cooked and slightly charred.
Warm pita breads.
Make tzatziki with yogurt, cucumber, garlic, and dill.
Fill pitas with beef, tzatziki, tomatoes, and onion.
Wrap and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Beef Bibimbap
instructions: Marinate sliced beef in soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, and sugar.
Cook spinach, bean sprouts, and carrots separately, season each.
Fry beef until cooked. Set aside.
Make bibimbap sauce: gochujang, sesame oil, garlic, sugar, and vinegar.
Divide hot rice into bowls, arrange vegetables and beef on top.
Add a fried egg and drizzle with bibimbap sauce.

recipes.title: Beef Satay
instructions: Cut beef into cubes and marinate in soy sauce, turmeric, garlic, and lemongrass.
Thread onto skewers and grill over high heat for 2-3 minutes per side.
Make peanut sauce: blend peanut butter, coconut milk, soy sauce, lime, and chili.
Serve satay with peanut sauce and cucumber slices.
Garnish with crushed peanuts and fresh cilantro.

recipes.title: Picanha Steak
instructions: Score the fat cap in a crosshatch pattern. Season only with coarse salt.
Cook fat side down in a cast iron pan over medium heat for 5 minutes to render fat.
Flip and sear each side over high heat for 3-4 minutes.
Rest for 10 minutes.
Slice thinly against the grain and serve with farofa and vinaigrette.

recipes.title: Beef and Vegetable Soup
instructions: Brown beef pieces in a large pot. Remove.
Saute onion, celery, and carrots until soft.
Return beef with beef broth, diced tomatoes, and bay leaves.
Simmer for 1 hour until beef is tender.
Add potatoes, corn, and green beans. Cook 20 more minutes.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Grilled Salmon with Lemon Butter
instructions: Pat salmon fillets dry and season with salt, pepper, and olive oil.
Grill skin side down over medium-high heat for 4-5 minutes.
Flip and cook 3 more minutes.
Make lemon butter: melt butter with lemon zest, lemon juice, and capers.
Pour lemon butter over salmon and serve with asparagus or green beans.

recipes.title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Cook linguine in salted boiling water until al dente.
Saute garlic in butter and olive oil until golden.
Add shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side.
Pour in white wine and lemon juice. Simmer 2 minutes.
Toss with drained pasta and fresh parsley.
Season with salt, pepper, and chili flakes.

recipes.title: Fish and Chips
instructions: Make batter: mix flour, baking powder, salt, and cold beer until smooth.
Cut potatoes into thick chips. Par-boil for 5 minutes. Drain and dry.
Deep fry chips at 160C for 5 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Dip fish fillets in batter and deep fry at 180C until golden, about 5 minutes.
Increase oil to 190C and fry chips again until crispy.
Serve with mushy peas, tartar sauce, and malt vinegar.

recipes.title: Paella
instructions: Saute onion, garlic, and red pepper in olive oil in a paella pan.
Add chorizo and cook 3 minutes.
Stir in rice and coat in the oil.
Add saffron-infused broth and crushed tomatoes. Do not stir.
Add shrimp, mussels, and squid on top. Cook uncovered 20 minutes.
Let rest 5 minutes, then garnish with lemon and parsley.

recipes.title: Tuna Poke Bowl
instructions: Cook sushi rice and season with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt.
Cube sashimi-grade tuna and toss with soy sauce, sesame oil, and ginger.
Divide rice into bowls.
Arrange tuna, avocado, cucumber, edamame, and shredded carrot on top.
Drizzle with spicy mayo and soy sauce.
Garnish with sesame seeds, nori strips, and green onion.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Lobster Tails
instructions: Split lobster tails in half lengthwise with kitchen scissors.
Season with salt, pepper, paprika, and olive oil.
Broil cut side up for 8-10 minutes until opaque.
Make garlic butter: melt butter with garlic, lemon juice, and parsley.
Spoon garlic butter over lobster and broil 2 more minutes.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges and crusty bread.

recipes.title: Miso Glazed Cod
instructions: Mix white miso, mirin, sake, and sugar to make the glaze.
Coat cod fillets with miso glaze and marinate 30 minutes.
Broil or grill for 5-6 minutes until caramelized and cooked through.
Serve with steamed bok choy and jasmine rice.
Garnish with sesame seeds and sliced green onion.

recipes.title: Prawn Curry
instructions: Saute onion in oil until golden. Add garlic and ginger.
Add curry powder, turmeric, and chili. Cook 2 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add prawns and cook for 5 minutes until pink.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Salmon Teriyaki
instructions: Make teriyaki sauce: combine soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar. Simmer until slightly thickened.
Season salmon with salt and pan-fry skin side down in oil for 4 minutes.
Flip and cook 2 more minutes.
Pour teriyaki sauce over salmon and glaze for 1 minute.
Serve with steamed rice, broccoli, and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Ceviche
instructions: Cut fresh fish into 1cm cubes. Place in a glass bowl.
Pour lime juice over fish, making sure all pieces are submerged.
Marinate in the fridge for 15-20 minutes until opaque.
Add red onion, aji amarillo, cilantro, and salt.
Serve immediately with sweet potato, corn, and cancha corn nuts.

recipes.title: Baked Cod with Tomatoes
instructions: Place cod fillets in a baking dish.
Scatter cherry tomatoes, olives, capers, and garlic around the fish.
Drizzle with olive oil, add white wine and lemon juice.
Season with salt, pepper, and dried oregano.
Bake at 200C for 20-25 minutes until fish flakes easily.
Serve with crusty bread to soak up the juices.

recipes.title: Lobster Bisque
instructions: Saute lobster shells in butter with onion, celery, and carrot.
Add tomato paste, brandy, and white wine. Cook 5 minutes.
Add fish stock and thyme. Simmer 30 minutes.
Strain through a fine sieve. Return to pot.
Add cream and blend until smooth.
Add lobster meat, season, and serve with crusty bread and fresh chives.

recipes.title: Grilled Octopus
instructions: Simmer octopus with bay leaves, peppercorns, and wine for 45-60 minutes until tender.
Remove and cut into portions. Pat dry.
Drizzle with olive oil and grill over high heat until charred, 3-4 minutes per side.
Make dressing: olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, capers, and parsley.
Serve warm with dressing, roasted peppers, and crusty bread.

recipes.title: Fish Tacos
instructions: Season fish with cumin, chili, garlic powder, and salt.
Grill or pan-fry for 3-4 minutes per side until cooked.
Make slaw: shredded cabbage with lime juice, cilantro, and salt.
Make chipotle crema: mix sour cream, chipotle, and lime.
Warm corn tortillas.
Fill with fish, slaw, and crema. Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Sushi Rolls
instructions: Cook sushi rice and season with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt. Cool.
Place nori sheet on a bamboo mat, spread rice leaving 2cm at top.
Add cucumber, avocado, and salmon strips in a line.
Roll tightly using the mat, seal with water.
Cut into 8 pieces with a wet sharp knife.
Serve with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger.

recipes.title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Cook bacon in a pot until crispy. Remove and set aside.
Saute onion and celery in bacon fat until soft.
Add potatoes, clam juice, and thyme. Simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in clams and heavy cream. Heat gently.
Season with salt and white pepper.
Serve in bread bowls topped with bacon and fresh chives.

recipes.title: Shrimp Pad Thai
instructions: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 20 minutes. Drain.
Mix fish sauce, tamarind paste, sugar, and lime juice for sauce.
Stir-fry shrimp in oil until pink. Push to side.
Scramble eggs in the pan.
Add noodles and sauce. Toss over high heat.
Serve with bean sprouts, peanuts, lime, and green onions.

recipes.title: Moules Frites
instructions: Scrub and debeard mussels. Discard any open ones.
Saute shallots and garlic in butter until soft.
Add white wine and bring to a boil.
Add mussels, cover, and steam for 5 minutes until all open.
Discard any that remain closed. Add cream and parsley.
Serve in large bowls with fries and crusty bread.

recipes.title: Shrimp Tacos with Mango Salsa
instructions: Season shrimp with cumin, chili, garlic, and lime juice.
Cook in a hot pan for 2 minutes per side.
Make mango salsa: diced mango, red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, and lime.
Warm corn tortillas.
Fill with shrimp and top with mango salsa and avocado.
Serve with extra lime wedges.

recipes.title: Bouillabaisse
instructions: Saute onion, leek, and fennel in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, tomatoes, saffron, and orange peel.
Pour in fish stock and white wine. Bring to a boil.
Add firm fish first, simmer 5 minutes.
Add shellfish and mussels, cook until they open.
Serve with rouille on toasted baguette slices.

recipes.title: Salmon Avocado Toast
instructions: Toast sourdough bread until golden.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and red pepper flakes.
Spread avocado on toast.
Top with smoked salmon, capers, red onion, and fresh dill.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon and black pepper.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Prawn Risotto
instructions: Saute shallot and garlic in butter. Add arborio rice and toast 2 minutes.
Add white wine and stir until absorbed.
Add hot prawn broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly.
After 18 minutes, stir in prawns and cook 3 more minutes.
Remove from heat, add butter and Parmesan. Rest 2 minutes.
Serve with lemon zest and fresh parsley.

recipes.title: Tuna Nicoise Salad
instructions: Boil eggs for 7 minutes. Cool and halve.
Blanch green beans for 3 minutes. Rinse in cold water.
Cook potatoes until tender. Halve.
Make dressing: Dijon mustard, red wine vinegar, olive oil, and herbs.
Arrange lettuce, tomatoes, olives, tuna, eggs, beans, and potatoes.
Drizzle with dressing and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Calamari Fritti
instructions: Cut squid bodies into rings. Pat dry thoroughly.
Season flour with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Toss squid in seasoned flour, shake off excess.
Deep fry at 180C for 2-3 minutes until golden.
Drain on paper towels immediately.
Serve with lemon wedges and aioli or marinara sauce.

recipes.title: Grilled Sea Bass
instructions: Score the fish on both sides 3 times. Season inside and out with salt and pepper.
Stuff cavity with lemon slices, garlic, and fresh herbs.
Brush with olive oil.
Grill over medium-high heat for 6-8 minutes per side.
Make salsa verde: blend parsley, capers, anchovy, garlic, lemon, and olive oil.
Serve with salsa verde and roasted vegetables.
